profile_text.body:
NVIDIA, founded in 1993 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, is a public company that reported revenue of $215,938,000,000 as of January 25, 2026. The company describes itself as building agentic AI with multimodal foundation models.

NVIDIA's Nemotron is a family of multimodal, open AI models designed for long-running, self-evolving agents and complex agent workflows. According to the company, Nemotron models deliver agentic reasoning for graduate-level science, advanced math, and visual understanding, with transparent training data and broad platform support. The Nemotron family includes the Nemotron 3.5 Lightning variant for specialized tasks and specialized models for speech recognition and retrieval. NVIDIA also offers NVIDIA NIM, inference microservices for deploying foundation models with enterprise GPU optimization and self-hosted options. Both products are available through build.nvidia.com. The company publishes Nemotron model weights, training datasets, and training techniques under the NVIDIA Open Model License, described as permissive and allowing commercial deployment without credit requirement.

NVIDIA operates in California, which has 220 cases listed in the held facts. The company provides NVIDIA AI Enterprise licensing for secure, scalable deployment and related support.
